questions.prompt: Is there a defect in how this worker pool handles a worker that fails mid-task? If so, mark the line(s) where it is; otherwise answer that there is none.
On an 8-core host, 50 invoices are submitted at once to a fresh pool. How are they processed?
choices: 50 workers are spawned, one per invoice
7 run concurrently and the remaining 43 wait in the queue, picked up as workers free
8 run concurrently and the rest wait
All 50 are posted to the 7 workers immediately and queue inside each thread

questions.prompt: 1,000 tasks are already queued and another compute() call arrives. What happens to it?
choices: It waits until the queue drops below 1,000
It is queued anyway; maxQueue is only a warning
It is rejected immediately with "invoice pool saturated"
It evicts the oldest queued task

questions.prompt: SIGTERM arrives while 7 invoices are in progress and 20 are queued. What happens to the 20 queued ones?
choices: They are processed before the workers terminate
They stay pending until the process exits
They are moved to the in-progress workers
